citation: Matsuyama,M.(1990),The Structure of the Nearshore Branch of the Tsushima Current on the Shelf off the San'in Coast in Summer,J.Oceanogr.Soc.Japan46,156-166.
source_locator: Printed158/PDFpage3,Table1 and Section2; printed159/Section4 defines the common table averaging interval and signed frames.
extraction_method: Manual transcription from retained original; Table1 visually verified on full-page image. No plot digitization or raw current-meter record acquisition.
geographic_scope: Five moorings on the continental shelf off San'in,Japan Sea; nearshore Tsushima branch only. Exact station coordinates are not digitized.
depth_boundary_interpretation: Two sampling depths are not layer boundaries. Opposite mean signs bracket a direction change only under continuity; zero-crossing uniqueness and physical current-bottom identity are unverified.
excluded_evidence: Temporal standard deviations are not current-depth errors.
Full31day A/B deployment means do not replace common19day Table1 means.
Bathymetry40/80/120m is not a current lower boundary.
Summer thermocline10-50m and separate H profile are not measured velocity-zero depths at these stations.
Modal width arithmetic,Eq8 sign and separate Figure10 longitude discrepancies remain unresolved and are not used.
